outcome: improves fit but unidentified (R1, not R3)

rules.R1_holdout_support: passes the stage A screen against M0 in the primary scenario
rules.R2_adequacy: the 95% interval of the shared noise multiplier contains 1.0 (adequate at the assumed 10% error); otherwise report the multiplier as the inadequacy factor
rules.R3_identification: every added parameter is classified identified or weakly identified; a mechanism whose added parameters are all bounded on one side only or prior dominated is 'improves fit but unidentified' even if R1 passes
